fichas.title: Checkout and Waiting Zones
fichas.summary: Illustrates checkout desk configurations and a self-service supermarket waiting zone. In specialised supermarkets with closed sales areas, checkout rows form the only exit; the passage width should allow shopping trolleys, pushchairs and wheelchairs to pass. Checkout types include single, area, floor, central and row arrangements, with conveyor belts and stationary scanners common.
uses: Providing accessible passage through checkout rows

dimensions.label: Minimum passage width between checkouts
dimensions.context: Passage between checkouts in specialised supermarkets; sufficient for trolleys, pushchairs and wheelchairs.
